blocks.label: Current Beat
blocks.body: The drifting things reach you, and they do not swing for your body. One presses a cold hand to a face and reaches inside, dredging up something buried. The other simply passes through a body like a door, and for a horrible moment a soul stands outside...

blocks.label: Public Objective
blocks.body: Survive the wraiths, protect each other, and keep the ritual on track.

affordances: Ask one practical question before acting.
